name: Front Squat (Paused)
instructions: Rest a barbell on the front of your shoulders with elbows high (clean grip or crossed arms).
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and brace your core.
Squat down until your thighs are at least parallel, keeping your chest tall.
Pause for 1 to 2 seconds at the bottom without relaxing.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.
longevityNotes: Squatting is the foundation of getting up, sitting down, and climbing stairs. Keeping leg strength and knee range preserves independence decades longer than any single other movement.
overview: A front squat with a one to two second pause at the bottom, which builds strength and control out of the hole.
